name: Independent cryptic crossword, Penguin book 1 No 28

clue.text: After a short time to study a philosopher is drudgery
Terrorist stirring to action: ‘Remove King!’
Supporting framework corrodes, bit moving out to front Horse needs a further halter
Order great changes in turn-about
Alarm is loud to the listener
Ruin vehicle when backing on to green
Source of good neighbour (it’s a girl)
Set into rough seas — being thus makes time stand still?

Stuck in hotel bathroom? It’s an isolated spot
Legal experts would protect street with fences
Any louder would spoil the song
There’s hint of sun around at home or it could be wet
Shrink from warm pyjama material? Not half!
Belligerent type getting heated about German
He may make disapproving sound or he may encourage student
Even without it, it’s fair

In short I am the top bod, a city showman

Relinquishing builder’s coat
Everything’s external flamboyance if one’s this?
Sun leads to earnest entreaty for irrigating device
